title: Own the output of a lazy range pipeline
prompt: Read integers, keep even values, square them in order, and return an owning vector. Inputs and squares fit int. A view may borrow its source; do not return a view that refers to a local input.

tests.label: Empty
tests.hint: An empty range yields an empty vector.

tests.label: Independent result
tests.hint: Copy the selected values into owned storage.

hints: A filter view selects elements only when visited.
A transform view maps each selected value. Copy its results into a vector before returning.
explanation: A range view can borrow data and perform work lazily. The final vector owns its elements after this function returns, even when the caller later changes its input.
chapterTitle: Building Data Pipelines with Ranges and Views
